title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for type 1 diabetes mellitus.

HPI
The patient presents today for a routine follow-up of their type 1 diabetes. They report stable management of their condition and state they are currently managed without complications. The patient continues to use insulin as their sole method of glycemic management and does not take any oral diabetes medication. They report consistent monitoring and adherence to their prescribed regimen.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Skin is intact. Vital signs are stable.

Assessment
Type 1 diabetes mellitus, currently without complications.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. The patient will continue to monitor glucose levels and report back for a follow-up appointment in three months. Education provided on consistent insulin administration.
explanations: No complication documented: type 1 diabetes without complications.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: No hyperglycemia or poor control is documented.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
